_note: Every image is pinned to an exact Wikimedia Commons file so the build is reproducible, and every alt description says what is actually in the photograph rather than what the product is. Commons has no photograph of a new retro-style tabletop radio (hhg-602), a modern printed recipe keeper (hhg-608), a large-print wall calendar (hhg-605) or an engraved walnut keepsake box (hhg-604); those four use the nearest honest subject and are on the pre-launch list to be replaced with real product photography before any ad runs. Two of them are photographs of genuinely old objects, which sits badly with this shop's own statement that nothing it sells is an antique — so they are a copy contradiction as well as a Merchant Center image-accuracy problem, not a cosmetic one.
